scientific.integrity: The general result is proved analytically from the published equilibrium equations and monotonicity assumptions. A standalone numerical replay checks one admissible parameter set and is not used as an infinite-parameter certificate.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns endemic-equilibrium comparative statics in the stated SEIR model. It does not establish monotone ordering of transient trajectories, optimize a vaccination schedule, or remove infection while infected inflow remains positive.

title: Vaccination monotonicity and an exact importation-amplification bound in an SEIR model
